local-hero-split.name: The "Local Hero" Split
local-hero-split.description: Horizontal 50/50 split showing location and practitioner
local-hero-split.psychology: This is real, they are near me, and they are open

pr-feature.name: The PR Feature (The "As Seen In")
pr-feature.description: Single professional hero image with media credibility bar
pr-feature.visualLayout: Single hero image with Media Bar overlay
pr-feature.psychology: Transferred authority - if they wrote about it, it must be legit

founders-promise.name: The "Founder's Promise"
founders-promise.description: Portrait with direct eye contact and personal touch
founders-promise.psychology: Accountability - a face behind the brand reduces fear of being scammed

comic-strip-agitator.name: The Comic Strip Agitator
comic-strip-agitator.psychology: Narrative transport - user sees themselves in the "Before" panel

us-vs-them-chart.name: The "Us vs. Them" Chart
us-vs-them-chart.description: Comparison table framing the rational choice
us-vs-them-chart.psychology: Logic bias - frames purchase as the only rational choice

old-way-new-way.name: The "Old Way vs. New Way"
old-way-new-way.description: Diagonal split showing evolution and progress
old-way-new-way.psychology: Evolution - implies not switching makes you outdated

iphone-note.name: The "iPhone Note" Screenshot
iphone-note.description: Native-looking personal note that blends into feeds
iphone-note.visualLayout: Exact replica of Apple Notes app
iphone-note.psychology: Native camouflage - feels personal and unpolished, bypasses ad blindness

testimonial-sandwich.name: The Testimonial Sandwich
testimonial-sandwich.description: Product centered with social proof above and below
testimonial-sandwich.psychology: De-risking - users trust other users more than the brand

ugc-still.name: The "UGC" Still (User Generated Content)
ugc-still.description: Authentic selfie-style content showing real usage
ugc-still.psychology: Authenticity - high-polish feels like a lie, low-polish feels like truth

exploded-view.name: The "Exploded View" (Ingredients)
exploded-view.psychology: Transparency - shows exactly what's inside, implies purity and potency

texture-shot.name: The Texture Shot (Sensory)
texture-shot.psychology: Sensory triggering - creates visceral desire to touch or taste

ugly-ad-doodle.name: The "Ugly Ad" (Doodle)
ugly-ad-doodle.description: Intentionally crude graphics that stand out
ugly-ad-doodle.visualLayout: Stick figures or MS Paint style graphics
ugly-ad-doodle.psychology: Novelty - looks so bad it stands out in a feed of perfect photos

warning-label.name: The "Warning Label"
warning-label.visualLayout: Bright yellow/red background with caution tape
warning-label.psychology: Curiosity gap - brain is wired to pay attention to warnings

notification-fakeout.name: The "Notification" Fakeout
notification-fakeout.psychology: Reflex - conditioned to check notifications immediately

copy-generation-main.name: Ad Copy Generation
copy-generation-main.description: Main prompt for generating ad copy variations with brand voice, product details, and campaign specifics

copy-field-regeneration.name: Field Regeneration
copy-field-regeneration.description: Regenerate a specific field (headline, body, or CTA) while maintaining brand consistency

ad-remix-deconstruction.name: Ad Template Deconstruction
ad-remix-deconstruction.description: Analyze a winning ad to extract its structural blueprint for reuse

ad-remix-reconstruction.name: Ad Template Reconstruction
ad-remix-reconstruction.description: Apply a proven ad blueprint to new brand/product data
